description: This is a Java test class for database update integration testing within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing Liquibase changelog application.

classes.name: DatabaseUpdaterDatabaseIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending DatabaseIT that verifies the database update process using Liquibase in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup method annotated with @BeforeEach; sets the Liquibase provider for database updates.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleanup method annotated with @AfterEach; unsets the Liquibase provider.

methods.name: should
methods.description: Test method annotated with @Test; verifies that the correct number of change sets are applied during database update.
